"import cadquery as cq

# Sketch plane: "XZ" so local (u, v) maps to global (x, y, z) = (u, 0, v)
P = cq.Plane.named("XZ")


def w(uv):
    """Map local sketch coordinates (u, v) to world coordinates."""
    return P.toWorldCoords((uv[0], uv[1]))


# Entity 1: Line from (26, 0) to (-4, -16)
edge1 = cq.Edge.makeLine(w((26, 0)), w((-4, -16)))

# Entity 2: Line from (-4, -16) to (-26, 0)
edge2 = cq.Edge.makeLine(w((-4, -16)), w((-26, 0)))

# Entity 3: Fitted spline through the fit points (smooth interpolation, no kinks)
fit_points = [(-26, 0), (-22, 19), (-11, 28), (0, 22), (11, 29), (22, 17), (26, 0)]
edge3 = cq.Edge.makeSpline([w(p) for p in fit_points])

# Exactly 3 curve entities forming one closed profile:
# (26,0) --line--> (-4,-16) --line--> (-26,0) --spline--> (26,0)
edges = [edge1, edge2, edge3]

# Export the curves as a compound of edges
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
